articles.title: U$4.97M Secured For Climate Adaptation in Gatsibo, Nyagatare, Kayonza
articles.summary: The government of Rwanda has secured a U$4.97Million from the Adaptation Fund to strengthen climate resilience among smallholder farmers in Kayonza,Gatsibo and Nyagatare districts.
